notes: Supplements (amino acids, nucleosides, adenine, thiamine, nitrate) are treated as medium properties (treatment none); glutathione left without treatment because it is neither clearly a nutrient nor a named stress. Single amino acid supplements: amino_acids_supplied false. Glucarate, gluconate and pyruvate classed organic_acid; sorbitol, ribose, N-acetylglucosamine, galactose other_sugar. bw_delpurR_cytd: purR deletion only from the title (strain field just BW25113). Nitrate samples: anaerobic by gas sparging, so culture_mode left out for them. Only plain wt_glc samples (no supplement, MG1655) are controls. WT re-read: unmodified baseline strain relabelled wild_type.

base_medium.q: inoculated into M9 minimal media with sample-specific carbon source

medium_class.q: inoculated into M9 minimal media with sample-specific carbon source, supplemented with 1 ml trace element solution (100X)
